notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
We’d like to share some fresh news about the development of Isolation One. The work is moving forward steadily, and a lot has been accomplished over the past months.

⚙️ Key achievements:

The project has been successfully migrated to Unity 6, giving us more possibilities to expand and refine the game.

Implemented URP (Universal Render Pipeline) – visuals are now more modern and polished, with improved performance.

📅 However, there’s also an important announcement: the release of the game has been postponed to 2026. We know many of you were hoping to play sooner, but this extra time will allow us to bring Isolation One to the level of quality it truly deserves.

Thank you so much for staying with us and supporting the project ❤️. More updates are coming soon – including new materials, screenshots, and dev diaries – so stay tuned!
